name: Wellington Bridge
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal length of that OSM way, WGS84 haversine with radius 6378137 m, rounded to one decimal. It is not a climb and not a structural length. An approach plan_length_m stops at the far node stored in the extract. That node is not a surveyed grade point. The mapped road centreline is not a published span length. The 23.78 m figure is an April 2024 preliminary out-to-out width, marked not for construction. It is not a plan_length_m.
dropped_note: This is 102 Avenue across Ramsey Ravine, between Churchill Crescent and Wellington Crescent. It is not G117, and it is not the river span. The City also calls the ravine Ramsey Ravine. Alberta's row says Wellington Ravine. The project list says Groat Ravine. River-span lengths, the river path width, and the river-pier notes are not copied. The 4.2 m shared-use path in the 2023 City update is this bridge's proposal. It is not the river bridge's east path.

dimensions.existing_type: Three-span concrete arch, City year 1932, sidewalk on each side, four lanes. Shoring since 2014.
dimensions.finished_type: Clear-span girder. Piers eliminated. Steel and concrete, including a NU2400 option, were both still in the bid set. No public award naming the built option was found.
dimensions.out_to_out_width_status: April 2024 drawing, marked not for construction. The August 2024 girder change said the permanent footprint should be reduced. A revised width was not found.
dimensions.width_2023_update_status: Printed in the 2023 update, when the recommended type was a concrete arch. The March 2026 page describes the girder and does not restate these widths.
dimensions.crossfall_april_2024_drawing: 2.5 percent on the bridge deck, then 4.0 percent, then a parabolic crown. Drawing marked not for construction.
